landing.heroSubtitle: A finance hub for builders and traders: launch your own token with liquidity in minutes, subscribe to crypto signal algos and forward them to your community, and follow live market data for the instruments you care about. Pay in USDC — no infrastructure fees.
landing.createBody: Name, symbol, supply, logo and metadata — from a guided wizard to a live Solana token in minutes.
createBullets: Token + on-chain metadata live in minutes — mint & freeze authority stay with you
Liquidity pool set up automatically, tune LP% with a slider
Fees paid in USDC; network gas comes from your built-in wallet
Every token gets a profile page with chart, stats and comments
landing.algoBody: Publish your trading signals as an algo — free or paid — and let subscribers receive every signal automatically.
algoBullets: Anyone can publish: free, one-time lifetime, or monthly USDC subscriptions
Public signal feed — everyone sees it, subscribers unlock output slots
Auto-forward signals to Discord or any HTTP webhook, with retries
Flat platform commission per payment, set transparently by the admin

fees.title: How fees work
fees.intro: Every action can involve two separate costs — paid to different parties, in different tokens:
fees.usdcBody: Charged by Artian Capital Group for each service. Deducted from your USDC balance and settled on-chain to the platform treasury. The amounts below are live.
fees.solBody: Paid by you from your SOL balance directly to the Solana network. The platform never pays gas for you and does not top up your wallet. Keep enough SOL before each action.
fees.rentNote: Storage rent is refunded to you whenever accounts are closed (empty token accounts, removed liquidity).
